description: This file provides a logging system for an application, including log level configuration, label parsing, and handlers for OS logging and file logging. It defines enums for log settings and levels, utility functions for label handling, and classes/structs implementing logging handlers with support for metadata and privacy. It also extends the Logging.Logger to facilitate custom initialization with subsystem and category.

classes.name: OpenClawOSLogHandler
classes.description: A log handler that outputs logs to the Apple OS Log system, supporting different log levels and metadata merging.

classes.name: OpenClawFileLogHandler
classes.description: A log handler that writes logs to a file, including metadata and contextual information.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level from user defaults.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the current log level in user defaults.

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file logging is enabled based on user defaults.

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Provides the default log level for the application.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the display title for a log level.

methods.name: bootstrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes the logging system if it hasn't been set up yet.

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Constructs a label from subsystem and category.

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label into subsystem and category components.
